set.body: Part of Epic bd-01KWVWM8ZP57V019JT646QA37N. Strengthen fit-layer GLS tests around multiple runs, run-specific estimated AR coefficients, censor resets at run boundaries and interior rows, selected-timepoint mapping, and multivoxel responses. Acceptance: fitJVM/test and fitJS/test pass; tests distinguish global vs run pooling and catch row/timepoint indexing mistakes.
set.title: Slice 18: multirun GLS and censor-layout hardening
